source: Supplied Mega Man5 USA ROM, actual fresh Start opens pause menu
renderer: JSNES2.1.0 full APU, NOT a Mesen execution/capture
musicStop: Original F0 command via sound ring; warm tail verified zero
processing: PCM16 conversion; trim only PCM-zero silence, retain5ms silent margin each side. No normalization, fades, synthesis or isolated channels.
scope: Menu-open effect only. No close/move/confirm sounds or GMS menu implementation.
